prompt_short: Our tag descriptions have changed — push the updates

assertions.text: Response asks for the vocabulary .md file path before running (Step 1 gating — no file path in prompt)
assertions.evidence: Response explicitly asks 'Which vocabulary file do you want to push?' and lists candidate files before proceeding.

assertions.text: Response references the publish workflow or indicates changed descriptions will be updated and unchanged ones skipped
assertions.evidence: Response states 'the [UPDATED] tags with changed descriptions will be patched in OpenMetadata automatically — everything already in sync will be skipped'.

assertions.text: Response does NOT say all tags will be deleted and recreated
assertions.evidence: No mention of deletion or recreation anywhere in the response. It describes a patch/update flow with skipping unchanged items.
